people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem

translations.web: Abimelech came to the tower and fought against it, and came near to the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
translations.bsb: When Abimelech came to attack the tower, he approached its entrance to set it on fire.
translations.kjv: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and went hard unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
translations.asv: And Abimelech came unto the tower, and fought against it, and drew near unto the door of the tower to burn it with fire.
